notes.title: Patch 5 - Ratings Update!
notes.notes: [p]Dear players,[/p][p][/p][p]After a few days in Open Beta, the major patch (versions 01.07.01 and 01.07.02) is  going live and is now available for everyone! [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🛠️ Patch Notes:[/h2][p][/p][h3]Visuals:[/h3][list][*][p]Added Tour de France 2025 special jerseys for Bora-Hansgrohe and Israel-Premier Tech teams. \[01.07.02][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556222/eaab11b00293abbcf5a0f99cfb55cc56acccea37.png"][/img] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556222/4f53fb15195ccbacbe3c2af54a402ddb80479bdb.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed jersey issues for Decathlon Ag2r La Mondiale and Lotto teams. \[01.07.02][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Gameplay:[/h3][list][*][p]Legend Mode: crash detection on the roadside is now less punishing.[/p][/*][*][p]Slight increase in the number of riders that can be involved in a mass crash.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Opponent Behavior:[/h3][list][*][p]In short stage races with no major difficulties, there has been no early breakaways. \[01.07.02][/p][/*][*][p]AI riders were experiencing fatigue even when they still have feed supplies. \[01.07.01][/p][/*][*][p]Improved feed zone behavior to minimize position loss.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved feed behavior for domestiques: they now stop feeding if they drop too far back and will resume feeding if the race pace slows down.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Database:[/h3][list][*][p]Ratings update. \[01.07.02][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Leader jerseys now display correctly on the podium in Pro Team/Leader mode when playing consecutive races.[/p][/*][*][p]Sponsor banners may appear incorrectly on the podium when loading a save.[/p][/*][*][p]Commissaire’s car is too close during descents, reducing visibility.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Optimizations[/h3][list][*][p]Crash fixes.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556222/06a1278b802c070edda0b4a4229154dd4cfc9784.png"][/img][/p][p]>> [url="https://linktr.ee/cyclinggames"]https://linktr.ee/cyclinggames[/url] <<[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2511320/Tour_de_France_2025/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Patch 4 now live - TDF Jerseys and Trading Cards!
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]After a few days in Open Beta, the major patch (version 01.06.00) is going live and is now available for everyone! [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your feedbacks![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🛠️ Patch Notes:[/h2][p][/p][h3]Visuals[/h3][list][*][p]New ghost appearance in Moment Descent.[/p][/*][*][p]New jerseys: Visma Lease a Bike, Ineos Grenadiers, Groupama FDJ, Lidl Trek.[/p][/*][*][p]TDF25 edition jerseys: Visma Lease a Bike, Groupama FDJ, UAE Team Emirates, Tudor, Lotto, TotalEnergies.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Gameplay[/h3][list][*][p]Adjustment: in Pro Team/Leader, T. Pogacar now targets a form peak in April instead of May.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustment: in Pro Team/Leader, riders now earn Pro Cycling ranking points during team time trials.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: in Pro Team/Leader, teams no longer earn too many Pro Cycling Points after a team time trial.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: in Pro Team/Leader, the same stage no longer appears twice in a row.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: in Pro Leader, during World Championships, the player’s teammates are no longer extremely weak.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: in Pro Leader, objectives at the World Championships can no longer be completed without being selected.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: the higher the difficulty, the more the Follow mode favored the player unfairly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: in My Tour, riders' recovery could become inconsistent with their stats.[/p][/*][/list][h3]AI Behavior[/h3][list][*][p]New: AI effort management on the final climb of a stage has been reworked to reduce unrealistic breakdowns.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustment: general classification outsiders aiming for the top 20 have more freedom to attack early in the race.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustment: early breakaways set a slightly lower pace in the first climbs to stay together longer and improve their chances of winning.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustment: in hilly stages, favorites manage their energy better for the final climb.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: general classification outsiders make their team work even though it should be the leader teams’ responsibility.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: a team chases the breakaway even though it has the strongest rider in the break.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: some riders refuse to collaborate in a breakaway to protect their leader, even when there's no threat to the leader.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: sometimes during the final climb, the early breakaway rides slowly and no attacks occur.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: attacking with a favorite and the entire team doesn’t trigger a reaction from opponents.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: in a breakaway, some riders try to take strong turns without having the energy, disrupting the relay.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Interface[/h3][list][*][p]Fix: special jerseys (Flanders, Giro) were not displayed in the interface.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: certain special characters were not displayed in rider names.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Database[/h3][list][*][p]Update: 2025 national champions.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Club Tour[/h3][list][*][p]Fix: wind zones disabled in Moment Race.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: in MyTour, the starting location differs from the one selected in the menus.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: TurboGel was missing for teammates.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: in rankings, the player’s name was incorrect if Watts were set to 0.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Optimizations[/h3][list][*][p]Crash fixes.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced memory usage in menus.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes for MyNacon connection issues.[/p][/*][/list][h3]PC[/h3][list][*][p]Fix: game launch issue without Steam.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: improved support for Steam Input.[/p][/*][*][p]Added: option to limit FPS.[/p][/*][*][p]Added: option to select the controller display style (Xbox, PlayStation).[/p][/*][*][p]Added: Trading Cards are now available on Steam.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556222/cd5ed40dd1d33454b10d16a75e7f5d258e80da2d.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556222/80b3a3d560d2c375b6470cb4965aed8d01b41043.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Steam Deck[/h3][list][*][p]We are now verified![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556222/4c1004429ac5fc908e928749fbc1844efd82f365.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556222/06a1278b802c070edda0b4a4229154dd4cfc9784.png"][/img]>> [url="https://linktr.ee/cyclinggames"]https://linktr.ee/cyclinggames[/url] <<[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2511320/Tour_de_France_2025/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Patch 1 - Major patch is live!
notes.notes: [p]Dear players,[/p][p][/p][p]After a few days in Open Beta, the major patch (version 01.04.02.1147) is going live and is now available for everyone! [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🛠️ Patch Notes:[/h2][p][/p][h3]Visuals[/h3][list][*][p]Improvement: More realistic lighting and skies in stages[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: More realistic transitions between grass and dirt areas[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: Updated podium for fictional races[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: Reduced ghosting effects of wheels in dark areas[/p][/*][*][p]Addition: Vuelta and Italia jerseys in MyTour influence the sponsors displayed during races[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Riders flying at the start of an individual time trial[/p][/*][*][p]Update: Canyon frames for Movistar and Alpecin[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Gameplay[/h3][list][*][p]Adjustment: Easier to stay in the wheels during the finale of a stage ending in a bunch sprint[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustment: Opponents no longer push the player’s riders in tight corners[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustment: 1 extra second of effect for TurboGel[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustment: 1 additional second before the automatic triggering of TurboGel[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustment: Slight reduction in the number of cases where leaders skip major races[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustment: Reduced influence of the Hills stat on cobbled climbs[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Simulating Paris-Roubaix in Pro Team/Leader results in unrealistic winners[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Riders do not stand on the pedals in time trials[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Wind protection in sprint trains was incorrectly calculated, causing energy inconsistencies[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Flèche Wallonne trophies do not unlock under the correct conditions[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Incorrect display of information panels in menus[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Pro Leader general classification missions can be completed in classics[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: “Pass a Mountain Grand Prix in the lead” missions can be validated in classics[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Variant stages do not trigger[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]AI Behavior[/h3][list][*][p]Fix: A co-leader no longer waits for a dropped co-leader to help[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: A good sprinter who is dropped and has no energy left is no longer waited for[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: In bunch sprints, riders no longer try to follow exhausted riders[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: AI riders are more likely to collaborate with the player in breakaways, reducing cases where they do nothing[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: Increased energy consumption for riders in the grupetto[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Interface[/h3][list][*][p]Addition: Warning message during races when AI wants the player’s team to lead the chase[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Incorrect race icon in the fitness calendar in Pro Team/Leader[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Incorrect icons for “TurboGel and Attack” and “Follow Attacks” commands[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: “Take TurboGel and Relieve” command is unavailable even when the rider has TurboGel[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Incorrect “Follow Attacks” icon after the final feeding zone[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Commands are grayed out when selecting multiple riders[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: TurboGel effect is lost if used from the radio menu and the menu is then closed[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Credits continue to scroll over other menus[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Texts contain development characters[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Riders switched from "starter" to "substitute" are not sorted correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Rider names during races are not correctly placed[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: In Pro Team/Leader, the game purchases the rider at the top of the list, not the one selected[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Database[/h3][list][*][p]Updated rider stats[/p][/*][*][p]Updated startlist for Critérium du Dauphiné[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Legends[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected national teams for Legends[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Club Tour[/h3][list][*][p]Improvement: Automatic reconnection in the lobby when the connection is restored[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: All riders stop just after the finish line[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: “One rider per team” setting has no effect[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Miscellaneous[/h3][list][*][p]Improvement: No longer necessary to restart the game for premium pack stages to appear[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Various crash
